findings.test: REQ-002 AC4: Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.
findings.explanation: After a first bid of 100 was accepted, a second bid of 100 (not at least 1 higher) resolved instead of rejecting. The test is consistent with the criterion, so the minimum bid check is wrong. Possible causes: the highest bid is not updated on the item after the first bid, or the comparison allows equal amounts.
findings.proposedFix: In BidService.placeBid, once an item has a highest bid, reject any amount below highestBidAmount + 1. Make sure an accepted bid sets item.highestBidAmount and highestBidderId and the item is saved with saveItem.
